definitions.cell: Each upload with a valid latitude and longitude is placed in the grid cell [floor(lat / cell_deg) * cell_deg, +cell_deg) x [floor(lon / cell_deg) * cell_deg, +cell_deg), in degrees (WGS84 as entered at upload). Latitude 90 and longitude 180 fall in the cell below. One degree of latitude is about 111 km; a degree of longitude shrinks with cos(latitude). The cell is an aggregation unit, not a detection radius or a drift model.
definitions.contamination_flag: A sequence with contamination_flagged = true (as in GET /partner/summary).
definitions.novelty_flag: Same rule as GET /partner/summary: result_class is not known_species and it is possible_novelty or has novelty_score >= the deployment's novelty threshold.
definitions.reviews: open_reviews: reviews of the cell's analyses in state submitted, triaged or needs_evidence. open_urgent_reviews: those with triage_priority urgent.
definitions.scope: Uploads and analyses are selected by owner (user_id) and by their own created_at within [date_from, date_to] (UTC, both days inclusive), as in GET /partner/summary. A cell counts the in-scope analyses of the in-scope uploads that fall in it.
definitions.taxa: distinct_taxa counts distinct (predicted_taxon, taxon_rank) pairs over the cell's sequences, read decision-first (results[].decision when the orchestrator wrote one, else results[].predicted_taxon). Sequences with no predicted taxon are not counted.

notes: 1 upload(s) in scope have no coordinates and are not mapped.
